title: Water Treatment Plant Chemical Supply
summary: Supplied coagulants, biocides and dosing consumables for a 12-month contract covering a 40 MGD municipal treatment plant.
challenge: The plant's previous vendor had inconsistent PAC batch strength, forcing operators to overdose and still miss turbidity targets during monsoon season. Deliveries were ad-hoc and documentation rarely arrived with the tanker.
solution: Alliance Solutions ran a jar-test program with the plant's chemists to fix a PAC specification, then set up a scheduled weekly delivery with safety-stock levels held at our warehouse. Every consignment ships with batch certificates and MSDS, and a monthly QA review tracks dosing efficiency.
results: 18% reduction in chemical cost per megalitre treated
Turbidity consistently under 5 NTU through monsoon season

testimonial.quote: The first vendor in years whose tanker paperwork matched the delivery note. Dosing has been boring — in the best possible way.

title: Textile Mill Lubrication & Coating Program
summary: Consolidated 11 vendors into one supply program covering hydraulic oils, machine lubricants and machinery coatings for a 40,000-spindle spinning mill.
challenge: The mill was buying lubricants from a patchwork of local dealers with no consistency in viscosity grades, while machine frames needed repainting during the annual shutdown with a coating that could handle humid processing halls.
solution: We standardized the mill on three viscosity grades of hydraulic and machine oil with scheduled monthly deliveries, and supplied an epoxy-based machinery paint system with primers for the shutdown repaint — including application guidance for their maintenance crew.
results: Procurement paperwork cut from 11 vendors to 1
Bearing-related stoppages down 23% year over year
Shutdown repaint completed on schedule with a uniform finish

gallery.alt: Repainted machine frames during annual shutdown

title: Steel Furnace High-Temperature Coating
summary: Supplied and supported a heat-resistant coating system for furnace exteriors, exhaust stacks and material-handling equipment during a reline shutdown.
challenge: Conventional paints on the furnace exterior were blistering within weeks, making inspection difficult and corroding the casing underneath. The window during the reline shutdown was only nine days.
solution: Alliance Solutions specified a silicone-based heat resistant coating system rated for continuous 400°C+ service, delivered with surface-prep instructions and enough material staged on-site to complete the job in one window. Our technical lead was available by phone throughout.
results: Zero blistering after 14 months of continuous operation
Inspection rounds simplified by a uniform, intact finish
Coating applied entirely within the 9-day shutdown window

title: Pharma QC Laboratory Instruments Fitout
summary: Equipped a new quality-control laboratory with glassware, instruments and industrial electronics — from beakers to pH meters — against a GMP audit deadline.
challenge: The lab needed 200+ distinct lines of glassware, instruments and electronic components procured, delivered and documented within eight weeks to meet a GMP audit date. Previous suppliers quoted 12–16 week lead times on import items.
solution: We split the list into stocked lines (shipped within the week) and import lines (air-freighted in parallel), and supplied a single consolidated delivery with itemized documentation mapped to the lab's asset register.
results: All 200+ lines delivered within the 8-week window
Audit passed with zero procurement observations
Single vendor invoice replaced 14 expected purchase orders

title: Solar Farm Structure Fastener Supply
summary: Supplied hot-dip galvanized fasteners and anchor hardware for 18,000 mounting structures across a 100 MW solar farm, delivered in installation sequence.
challenge: The EPC contractor needed fasteners delivered not in bulk lots but in sequence with installation crews across a desert site — mixed kits per structure, weatherproof packaging, and zero tolerance for mixed grades.
solution: Alliance Solutions kitted hardware per 20 structures in labeled, UV-stable packaging with grade-specific QC checks before dispatch, and staged two weeks of inventory at a depot near the site.
results: Kitting cut installer hardware time by roughly 30%
Delivered ahead of the installation schedule every month
